name: mcollina/node-best-practices
summary: Node.js backend patterns for Xillow's Express API — async flow, error handling, graceful shutdown, logging, environment/secrets, performance, streams, and process diagnostics. Use when working on apps/api runtime code, server lifecycle, connection pools, or a hung Node process. Do not use for TypeScript type stripping or node:test setup — this repo runs Node >= 20 with tsx, tsc, and vitest.
